description: XRP balance, sequence, owner count, transfer rate and trust lines (capped) for an account. When to use: To inspect an account before building a transaction for it. Prefer another tool: Not for transaction history or reserves; it is a summary, not a full account dump. Example: xrpl_account_summary {"address":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

name: xrpl_account_summary

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amm_id.description: `AMMID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

balance_xrp.description: The account's XRP balance (`Balance`), a decimal string in XRP, not drops

domain.description: `Domain` decoded to text; null when absent

flags.description: AccountRoot flags of the account decoded to booleans

allow_trustline_locking.description: lsfAllowTrustLineLocking: the issuer lets holders' trust lines be locked by escrow

disable_master.description: lsfDisableMaster: the master key is disabled

disallow_incoming.description: Incoming checks, NFToken offers, payment channels and trust lines the account blocks

is_issuer.description: True when any fetched trust line balance is negative; null when none is and `lines_truncated` is true; else false

loan_broker_id.description: `LoanBrokerID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

signer_list_set.description: True when the account has a signer list (`SignerList`)

sponsored_owner_count.description: `SponsoredOwnerCount`; null when absent (the Sponsor amendment is not enabled)

sponsoring_account_count.description: `SponsoringAccountCount`; null when absent (the Sponsor amendment is not enabled)

sponsoring_owner_count.description: `SponsoringOwnerCount`; null when absent (the Sponsor amendment is not enabled)

ticket_count.description: `TicketCount`, the account's tickets; 0 when absent (its protocol default)

transfer_fee_pct.description: Transfer fee the account charges as an issuer, in percent: (TransferRate - 1000000000) / 10000000, exact; "0" when it sets none

balance.description: Line balance in units of `currency`; positive: the peer owes the account; negative: the account owes

currency.description: Canonical currency code (3 characters or 40 hex)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

line_limit.description: Limit the account sets, in units of `currency`

role.description: `issuer` when the balance is negative, else `holder`

vault_id.description: `VaultID`: set only on that pseudo-account; else null

title: Account summary
